notes.title: The Crackpet Show - 1.1.7 [Patch]
notes.content:
Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

We continue to support The Crackpet Show, and today we have a patch that addresses an issue that has affected the most hardcore members of our community. In some rare cases, after successfully defeating 15+ bosses in Endless Mode, the game could crash or slow down significantly. Everything from finding a fix for this issue to properly testing it wasn't easy, but we believe this should help make the fight for the top of the leaderboards less stressful.

We've also tweaked the behavior of Stimpack - especially in co-op, killing yourself with it could cause players to get stuck.

Fixing the above issues wouldn't be possible without your detailed feedback and sharing log files, so once again, THANK YOU! <3

[h2]1.1.7 Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed rare endless mode crashes on higher tier waves
[*] fixed advertising popup (easter egg) overlapping UI

notes.title: The Crackpet Show - Advent Calendar 4/6 [Endless Mode]
notes.content:
Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

We are just a few days ahead from the full release of The Crackpet Show, with the launch of one of the most exciting new additions ever - Endless Mode, putting Crackpets into ultimate mayhem in the massive stages, with infinite waves of enemies and random bosses from the campaign.

Let's dive deep into this brand-new mode so you can decide if you are up for an ultimate challenge prepared by Mr. Parrot.

[h2]Lobby with a twist[/h2]
When you enter a lobby in the Endless Mode for the first time, you will notice that Sponsors are not available in this mode. That's right - you need to focus on making a perfect build from scratch without additional support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/8c9f1c1d1d42d7561009847ac0f81de2f014e14f.jpg[/img]

But to ensure you won't die in the first room, we implemented two additions to the basic game mechanics: Healing Hearts, with health dropping from enemies, and Double Weapon, allowing you to wield two guns at a time.

[h2]Survive everything that Mr. Parrot throws at you[/h2]
In Endless Mode, you don't have the privilege of choosing a path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/0be3cb9ca38a7e6b3f016a21c404d966080612a5.gif[/img]

The first room you enter, like in the campaign, requires you to choose a perk. Then you enter a massive stage with a randomized layout and a different set of enemies each time. After clearing a boss, the biome and decoration set changes.

Enemies have a minor chance of dropping precious loot, so you need to hope for RNG to drop you a weapon to help you manage the fight. Survive ten waves of enemies to clear the room and prepare to kill a random boss from the campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/1a1544ecaa3384c8a7e986a3dc7796809bae12b7.gif[/img]

We have divided Bosses into tiers, so don't worry about fighting late Season 3 monsters right from the beginning. They also drop additional rewards and open another perk room, improving your build by constantly increasing the difficulty of enemies. All perks are equivalent to level 2 ones from the campaign.

[h2]Increasing the difficulty curve[/h2]
Our desire was never to force you to grind for hours, so with every 10 waves, you can expect a significant increase in enemies' health. After clearing a few rooms, you might start noticing higher-level weapons, which with an increasing pool of perks should keep you up and running. The rest is up to your skills, precision, and aiming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/2df790c9a7681788206f7cd68380c68cd86e94a6.gif[/img]

[h2]Online Leaderboards[/h2]
Instead of usual likes, you get a score for each kill in this mode. It all adds up to a final score that will show up on online Steam Leaderboards, together with the last wave you made it. That's an entirely new level of fame - so don't screw it up. And best of all, if you play in a local co-op, you will see individual scores for each player, so now you will know who keeps the team in play and which one needs more support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/4faed70b6783466e6426f0e51c26e67deda2dd11.jpg[/img]

[h2]How to access Endless Mode?[/h2]
Mr. Parrot thinks that if you successfully beat the first season of The Crackpet Show, you should be ready for the challenge. Then this option becomes available in the main menu.

However, we recommend playing this mode after clearing most of the campaign to avoid spoilers and take the fun from unlocking weapons and perks.

[h2]When will I be able to play Endless Mode[/h2]
Endless Mode is a part of our colossal launch update of The Crackpet Show, which opens on December 15th! So make sure you've secured your ticket for the Finale:

notes.title: The Crackpet Show - Advent Calendar 3/6
notes.content:
[b]Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,[/b]

Do you know this lovely feeling when your favorite show gets more enjoyable with each season? Well, the best thing about [b]The Crackpet Show[/b] is that we've been revamping everything from [b]Episode 1 to 18[/b] during this whole year of Early Access. So now it's the best time to jump back into the most bizarre show with cute yet violent animals. And to make things easier here is everything that changed throughout the year.

[h2]So, here is the 3rd part of our Advent Calendar - 1 Year in Early Acces Changes. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/b461b0329f569bc15bb79bf3f87dd96ff149ce1e.jpg[/img]

But, before we start, make sure that you have tried our free [b]Prologue[/b], featuring 3 episodes from the first Season:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216280/The_Crackpet_Show_Prologue/

[h2]Introduction of Season 3[/h2]
With Crackpets moving to Petopolis, we've opened an entirely new biome with 6 new exciting bosses, including the final encounter and a big show Finale! This time you need all the sponsor power and the best combination of perks, special items, and weapons to beat the [b]Blind Hugger, Blood Brothers[/b], or deadly [b]Cockroach The Builder[/b].

[h2]Endless Mode with Online Leaderboards[/h2]
After beating [b]Season 1[/b], you will receive access to an entirely new game mode that uniquely blends everything [b]The Crackpet Show[/b] has to offer in a completely new randomized way. Go through the largest rooms yet, clear 10 waves of enemies, and beat the random boss to fight for the high score in online leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/63d13db189a84963cbac61ae41487b1e6297f53a.gif[/img]

[h2]New room types & layouts and decorations[/h2]
Each biome has [b]8 new room layouts[/b] with 4 variants, giving you 32 new additional mayhem playgrounds with a new set of decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/d24bf1565629a45d4c311e5aff25fef510e90022.jpg[/img]

We've also added entirely [b]new room types[/b]:

[b]Upgrade Room[/b] - the only way of getting everything out of your weapons, giving you access to level 4. Remember, the first upgrade is for free. For more, you need likes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/247cffe47c0d7f174f33012930a356bda1012b48.gif[/img]

[b]Stash Room[/b] - sometimes you need the power right from the start. So now you can place a weapon in a magic red fridge that makes a copy of it, giving you a chance to take it out at the start of a different episode. How neat! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/3ff3738a1a5fb681bda819aa17f0ac27fc29c80f.gif[/img]

All of the above are accessible via sponsor upgrades.

[h2]Character skins[/h2]
The Crackpet Show is all about fame and style too! Kill 5 bosses, grab the skin cards, and put them in the shiny new machine in the lobby to get a random outfit for your beloved characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/4b91439323d150d0d4764f0744ec147efa182e1f.gif[/img]

For the full version, there are 24 of them, with 8 new ones coming soon + 2 additional ones inspired by Admiral Bahroo's avatar. So this gives us a whooping [b]34 outfits for Crackpets.[/b]

[h2]New music + main theme[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/4c94d9ab5b747d77db83abf5a1a5dff81757abfb.jpg[/img]

With the 1.0 version, we are introducing a main theme composed by [b]Jerome Rossen[/b], the mind behind every single note found in every single episode of the cult classic splatter comedy [b]Happy Tree Friends[/b]. We also have new tracks for combat and bosses to enhance the fun and violence of the show.

[h2]New weapons/perks/special items[/h2]
Since the launch of [b]Early Access[/b], we've added tons of new weapons, perks, and special items. Let's take a look at our favorite addition to each of the categories.

[b]Weapon: Random Gun[/b] - This magic gun shoots like any other weapon swapping between them with each shot. If you can't decide which works best for you, this is the one for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/daafe4235a586669649a23637695437205d6c201.gif[/img]

[b]Perk: Short Circuit[/b] - The show became more electrifying after introducing this perk to the pool. Add electric powers to your tools of mayhem, and watch how your enemies die quickly. And it also works on barrels, saving time for all participants looking for precious loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c00cb71515f15f1f9c7d1506e62491b4464d6ac3.gif[/img]

[b]Special Item: Manifesto[/b] - The Crackpet Show is famous for its die-hard fans, but now they can show their dedication by joining the mayhem and fighting on your side! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/6925bcd094fad104931962f954137c254c6c93b4.gif[/img]

[h2]Critical hits mechanic[/h2]
During Early Access, we've introduced a Critical Hits system with a set of new dedicated sponsor upgrades, perks, and special items. It opened up an entirely new wave of builds focused on close-quarters fighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c727efc49b134ef889c6e6a1433aa9e53b6bfd1c.gif[/img]

[h2]Rebalancing[/h2]
During the entire Early Access, we've been gathering reports from the community and checking stats of deaths and most efficient weapons to find a golden sweet spot for an overall balance.

As a result, we've reworked how the beginning of The Crackpet Show works, giving enemies a new attack pattern, making it easier to pick up your friends in co-op, and boosting special items significantly to make them more useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c04b04799c59344317f28be4cb4a82e9289c5f52.gif[/img]

[h2]QoL improvements[/h2]
There are tons of small changes that should make playing The Crackpet Show more enjoyable, to name a few:
[list]
[*]When restarting an episode, you go back to the character you previously selected
[*]Introduced background for characters in co-op
[*]Make picking up stuff for hold instead of press
[*]Improve the camera work
[*]Make mines more useful by activating between themselves
[*]Make the area of effects damaging barrels
[*]Introduced a new end summary screen with detailed stats 
[/list]
[h2]Easter eggs and a secret room[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/e2450a12dfb3740ec001252740a16934089ab25b.gif[/img]

Have you noticed the addition of a secret room with one of the Early Access updates? Even we have trouble finding it. But it's worth looking for to discover Mr. Parrot Secrets!

And last but not least, easter eggs are in the launch version. We don't want to spoil the surprise, so we will leave you with a small hint for reading the article to the end. Try to stand still in a lobby for a few minutes and see what happens. 👀

As you can see, now is the best time to secure the first row for [b]The Crackpet Show[/b] and enjoy everything it offers [b]on December 15th[/b].

notes.title: Update 0.17.1 - QoL changes!
notes.content:
Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

here are promised the QoL changes as we said in our date reveal announcement. All details below!

[h2]QoL changes[/h2]

[b]Hold to pick up/hold to drop[/b] - whenever you want to pick up any weapon or a special item, you now need to keep holding the assigned button. We know it alternates the game flow, but during beta testing of a brand-new mode, we saw a high increase in accidental weapon swaps. If you want to drop a weapon or item, you hold it slightly longer to confirm it was your intention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f1f7379b1859274b854740f2d9d6b89485fb7237.gif[/img]

[b]Improved camera behavior[/b] - the camera zoom should now adjust more smoothly and eliminate situations when you could be outside of the screen's border.

[b]Improved players' visibility[/b] - another change for co-op. Each character now has a distinctive background to make it easier to spot your Crackpet even in the middle of the most intense mayhem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/bcbbe2a37d0a70a9c0f04f0f9f265bb354a4162f.gif[/img]

[b]New end screen[/b] - get more details about your performance and compete with your friends for the number of kills or damage done!

notes.title: The Crackpet Show - Making of through the Early Access
notes.content:
Dear animal freakshow lovers,

It's been a while, and you kept asking us about the future plans for [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]. Now we are back with the latest news from the set!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390700/The_Crackpet_Show/

We've decided to deliver one more update before releasing out of Early Access. Expect it later this month. BTW, the plan to go for the full launch this year remains unchanged (more on that very soon as well!). 

A lot has happened since winter! We thought now it's a perfect moment to reflect on the year and share some insights from the Vixa and The Crackpet Show.

🦈 [b]In January[/b], Sharky was crowned as the star of a show and continued to be the most commonly picked participant. Do you think he can be dethroned? We will check once again after the full release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c2568816a5d9bcce872b27da5c8ac1aca2d1d3f5.jpg[/img]

📆 Apart from releasing new updates, [b]February[/b] was also all about balancing. Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've managed to completely overhaul the game pacing in the first episode, adjust some weapons, and make Special items more powerful. Since then, we have been able to focus on tweaks and polishing only. Fingers crossed, it remains that way after full release as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/4ad7e9a17c7fa2045149cb76baea5d911c6073c5.gif[/img]

🐊 [b]In March[/b], new rooms started to show up! Compared to Early Access beginnings, you now have Upgrade, Healing & Stash rooms - all available via sponsor upgrades. The Upgrade one was the toughest from the balance point of few - we had to ensure that leveling your weapon one more level isn't going to throw away weeks of work on the difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/247cffe47c0d7f174f33012930a356bda1012b48.gif[/img]

📆 Around [b]April[/b], we started to look for new music for the game - we heard your feedback very loudly. We've found two composers, tested different mixes, and are satisfied with the result. Can't wait to share it with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/2ccc545c67fabd46220ca8796315e9a3ff95a957.png[/img]

🐔 [b]In May[/b], participants got enormous support from the crowd - as the audience joined the fight for the first time. This feature was definitely challenging to design. In the end, you can call for support at any time, including intense boss fights. As a result, we got one of the funniest bugs of the year, with the audience throwing punches and kicks at the enemy even after delivering a final blow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/d076c996f19842ea392eed78d592359a7cf4bab9.gif[/img]

📆 Fashion time began [b]in June[/b] with the introduction of the skin machine! Main inspirations? Spyro, KFC, Hollywood stars. As for now, you have one skin per character available, but the plan is to give you 4 options for each participant. Keep those precious skin cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/b6ca4b89cd5600e25524c8a46046465d1fcad57a.png[/img]

🐰 The summertime was also on the active side! We've introduced skins inspired by [b]Admiral Bahroo's[/b] and had our own booth at [b]Gamescom 2022[/b] for the first time ever! This was an utterly intense week during which we met hundreds of amazing people at our booth. The team of Sharks looking straight from The Crackpet Show will always be remembered! We've also showcased The Crackpet Show during [b]Tokyo Games Show 2022[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/2e751aa1f9f94dfd69c7c73b91b517798f4ecd9a.jpg[/img]

📆 [b]September[/b] was the time when you could try our brand-new endless mode. Thanks to feedback from the core members of our community, you can expect well-balanced gameplay with an engaging difficulty curve from day one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/02e521db37d8b56ea8f8a096c0c73976ee8b45c8.png[/img]

✨And that brings us to the summary of the last month, [b]October[/b]. Who will be the fastest to complete season 1? Looks like BlackWinter is the fastest so far! Last month we also had a cute visitor - we gave him the name Oscypek - after a typical Polish sheep cheese. :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/41db60723730a973ad374a861a0a45192523555a.png[/img]

notes.title: The Crackpet Show - Can we fix it? [0.13.2 content update]
notes.content:
Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

Time for the new 🅄🄿🄳🄰🅃🄴! Episode 17 with Cockroach the Builder is now available, so get ready to test your ultimate builds, and all the sponsor bonuses to face the enemy supported by a deadly machine! There are some new tools at your disposal - including two new special items, a new weapon, a perk, and more. There are some secrets here too!

Let's take a look at all the new additions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/615d1be76537dbd42fee833389d91fc1ee5968af.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]New episode - Can we fix it?[/b][/h2]
🪳 [b]Cockroach The Builder[/b] - of course, deadly machines exist in the world of [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]! You didn’t think that only good stuff like a sponsor arcade machine existed, right? Cockroach is the master of destruction, so be aware of his mech! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c3f920e2ded7fe2567c5d01247e4dfdebc391fb8.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New room layout pack[/b][/h2]
With this new update, you will immediately notice more room variety. This is a first pack consisting of 8 new regular stages, 4 counter stages, and 8 perk stages. Time to challenge your muscle memory!

[h2][b]New weapon[/b][/h2]
🌈 [b]Rainbow shotgun[/b] - Shoots five colorful bullets. The bane of the color-blind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/8134f69478c7ab68544249164e4300b16ba1fa9b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New perk[/b][/h2]
🔥 [b]Fire Sweat[/b] - When dashing, you leave behind a fiery area that deals damage to enemies! 

[h2][b]New special items[/b][/h2]
😵‍💫 [b]Blind shooting[/b] - Teach your enemies a lesson and shoot bullets in eight directions simultaneously! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/db90b63ac7e14d75737892fa2c7183cafc94698c.gif[/img]

👿 [b]Devil’s Arsonist[/b] - Creates a special symbol that ignites your enemies. Also, you can use it for barbequing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/beb9429de2cc90e2913b87a28304deacbc395b34.gif[/img]

[h3]Balance tweaks[/h3]
This patch’s balance changes focus on 3 major things:
[list]
[*] buffing less used weapons, nerfing some too powerful ones
[*] boosting special items, so they are more relevant
[*] boosting season 3 bosses
[/list]
[b]Weapon balance changes[/b]
Let’s start with buffs. Baseball Gun and Grow-o-Ball are the main ones scheduled for buffing, while Mega Railgun, Railgun, Love Spreader, and Rocket Launcher received minor adjustments. We have also tweaked some of the weapon markings. 

[b]Special items[/b]
When looking at the data of special item usage, we could see that non-healing item are not that important for you and could use some more utility. We buffed over 15 of them, plus gave entirely new features to mines - Explosive and Stinky ones now activate other mines in their damage radius.

[b]Boosting Season 3 bosses[/b]
We already said that season 1 and 2 bosses look mostly well balanced, but you still manage to win fights with the latest bosses. So let’s see how well you do after boosting Giant Turtle, Wack-a-Ctopus, Blood Brothers, and Blind Hugger. 

Check out the full changelog if you don’t want to miss anything (there are some QoL improvements there as well):

[h2]0.13.2 - changelog [/h2]
[h3]New content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Episode 17 with Cockroach the Builder boss
[*] New weapon - Rainbow Shotgun
[*] New perk - Fire Sweat
[*] New special - Blind Shoot
[*] New special - Devils Arsonist
[*] New room layouts pack 1 ( 8 regular stages, 4 counter stages, 8 perk stages)
[*] Secret rooms 
[/list]
[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lava Cannon is now marked as common
[*] Snowball Thrower is now marked as common
[*] Grenade Launcher is now marked as rare
[*] Shockwave Generator is now marked as rare
[*] BOWLING Gun bullets are slightly faster
[*] Chained Balls now have a lower projectile spread and slightly higher hit damage
[*] Baseball Gun damage increased
[*] Grow-o-Ball damage increased
[*] Mega Railgun damage reduced
[*] Railgun rate of fire slightly reduced
[*] Love Spreader rate of fire slightly reduced
[*] Rocket Launcher range reduced

notes.title: The Crackpet Show - Time to Upgrade - [0.12.3 content update]
notes.content:
Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

It’s the perfect time to come back to your favorite show with this new exciting U̳P̳D̳A̳T̳E̳! A brand new participant joins the show to fight! A new enemy with shield capabilities will make your life harder. But with new weapons, a new perk, and the powerful new special item, you will be more than capable of handling this job. And let’s not forget about another brand new room type!

[b]NOTE[/b]: [spoiler] We did a reset to trophies assignments yet again because of the brand new room type - [b]Upgrade Stage[/b]. More on that below. [/spoiler]

Let's take a look at what's new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/0de1e438f16c6860d28d601070f8b340160d6223.png[/img]

🐼[b]Panda[/b] - had to escape from a zoo when everyone realized he was not very GIFable and sweet enough. But to be free again, he had to put a bamboo stick inside his head (it's a long story), resulting in being even less sweet than before. But at least he might end up on GIFs thanks to joining [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/2d11a5c1f8b68474d62e87c23b81509bd155be7c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/d8030f7204598bbab01e5901f6f1f4630a1eedc7.gif[/img]

[h2]𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐠𝐮𝐧[/h2]

🔫[b]Turrets Launcher[/b] - Fires small turrets that deploy where they land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f124d27f45b2da9f117ffe89d010544eaac71337.gif[/img]

[h2]𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐤[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/dfedfa4a1fa2ba58977508637c0a1113ee271762.gif[/img]

[h2]𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐦[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/1700af83b1590b33d3a0b733289c08ca87dfb1fe.gif[/img]

But we also need to take into consideration the natural flow of progression for players that haven't been waiting for the updates. Thus, with this patch, we are not touching the game balance.

Check out the full changelog if you don’t want to miss anything (there are some QoL improvements there):

Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

Ⓝ Ⓔ Ⓦ  Ⓤ Ⓟ Ⓓ Ⓐ Ⓣ Ⓔ  is here! It’s time to come back to your favorite reality show and test your builds with a new challenging boss (actually two bosses in one), hunt for new achievements, give new weapon a try, unlock new special items and perks. It’s time to yell yet again: [b]THIS IS THE CRACKPET SHOW[/b]!

Let's take a look at what's new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/9ca7a5a0f7e7f0586c3372f3ed963c8f090be71c.jpg[/img]

[h2]𝕄𝕖𝕖𝕥 𝕥𝕙𝕖 𝕟𝕖𝕨 𝕡𝕒𝕣𝕥𝕚𝕔𝕚𝕡𝕒𝕟𝕥[/h2]

🐷 [b]Piggy[/b] - likes to clean things up, apart from himself. His favorite movie is Joker, and he would love to do some cosplay in the future. Prefers a violet color over pink.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/3b1188d18468b967492a50431fe51fa036601352.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/a7d7e827ddfad85ac4abd408953948a455977250.gif[/img]

[h2]ℕ𝕖𝕨 𝕡𝕖𝕣𝕜𝕤[/h2]

There is another new perk that touches the critical hit mechanic, plus a new one for those preferring chained attacks:

🎯 [b]Bullseye[/b]
Increases critical hit chance. Cow knows by how much.

💥 [b]Short Circuit[/b]
Shocks enemies near the target. Really shocking how it works.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/56e4c275fb52c81b34afe708a3ff6824d06e7ca6.gif[/img]

[h2]ℕ𝕖𝕨 𝕤𝕡𝕖𝕔𝕚𝕒𝕝 𝕚𝕥𝕖𝕞[/h2]

🧛 [b]Vampire[/b] - Risky, but it can be a lifesaver! It makes the next several enemy bullets heal you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/6c935b18568f5fefd378642d4c46fe0808a25a80.gif[/img]

[h2]ℕ𝕖𝕨 𝕖𝕟𝕖𝕞𝕪[/h2]

🧟‍♂️ [b]Necromancer[/b] - shoots homing skull projectiles and revives enemy corpses. Elite variants are more deadly plus resurrect enemies with much more health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/1fcbf38edb5afb5428837bc79c39e39b2d614ef8.gif[/img]

[h2]ℕ𝕖𝕨 𝕓𝕠𝕤𝕤[/h2]

🩸 [b]Blood Brothers[/b] - they share a strong bond, and ridiculously high attack speed. Even if you kill one of them, the danger doesn’t stop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/fab49089c160345b4f7acd47dd93f5d6f1503079.gif[/img]

You’ve also told us on Discord that Turbo Snails are a little bit annoying, so we reduced the invulnerability timer for them. Please, keep sharing your feedback, so we can continue to improve the show!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/3cf355da0714d4130fd86727207466cfb12f550f.jpg[/img]

Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

This week, on social media, we asked you to guess the new additions coming to the game. You could choose from new weapons, a new character, new room types, or a new boss. We are so happy to share that all the answers were correct, and you get ALL OF IT! (& more!)


[h2]😍 𝕸𝖊𝖊𝖙 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝖓𝖊𝖜 𝖕𝖆𝖗𝖙𝖎𝖈𝖎𝖕𝖆𝖓𝖙[/h2]

[b]🐊 𝐂𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐥𝐞[/b] - don’t be fooled by her sweet smile! Legend says she can bite four enemies at a time, each with a different tooth. Always keeps her head above the water. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/989a01bad087deeda32bfee8910833daff9f574d.gif[/img]


[h2]🏠 𝕹𝖊𝖜 𝖗𝖔𝖔𝖒 𝖙𝖞𝖕𝖊[/h2]

[b]🎁 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐬𝐡 𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐦[/b] - Now participants can take a breath and save their weapon for the next run. They probably won't, though, right? 😄

To unlock those rooms, you need to purchase the “Stash stages” sponsor upgrade. Due to changes with a sponsor tree, you need to reassign all your trophies after updating the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/3ff3738a1a5fb681bda819aa17f0ac27fc29c80f.gif[/img]


[h2]🔫 𝕹𝖊𝖜 𝖜𝖊𝖆𝖕𝖔𝖓𝖘[/h2]

[b]🥍 𝐁𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐋𝐚𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐫[/b] - This machine launches balls at high speeds that push away anyone they hit. The bat is a tight fit, but we managed it with some lube. 

[b]🎱 🎱 ⛓️ 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬[/b] - Shoots two balls connected with a chain. The chain slices through enemies, dealing damage. Did you expect a sex joke here? 🤣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/5330cdcc8100704d19c908c305b14d352148d1d6.gif[/img]


[h2]🎯 𝕮𝖗𝖎𝖙𝖎𝖈𝖆𝖑 𝖍𝖎𝖙 - 𝖊𝖓𝖍𝖆𝖓𝖈𝖊𝖉 𝖒𝖊𝖈𝖍𝖆𝖓𝖎𝖈𝖘[/h2] 

With [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1390700/announcements/detail/4977042432578804883]the second January content update[/url], you got a critical hit mechanic, giving you a small chance to hit the enemy with double the damage. Now, with a little bit of luck, you can increase those chances:

[b]Critical Power[/b] [perk] - Increases the damage multiplier for a critical hit.
[b]Critical Master[/b] [special item] - Temporarily makes ALL your shots critical. Pretty useful.
[b]Close Combat[/b] [sponsor bonus] - Any close-range shot is a critical hit.

notes.title: The Crackpet Show #2 January Content update - 0.9.5
notes.content:
Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

Mr. Parrot, our host of the show, is always right. He promised two content updates in January, and guess what? We got it for you today! The brave participants of [b]The Crackpet Show[/b] continue to explore Petopolis and now fight their way in Episode #14 to face another new boss - Wack-a-Ctopus!

[previewyoutube=xP-iKQMmLp4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Let’s take a look at all new additions:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/4d5ff8302015b58edd18650a56471644dbad6eb0.jpg[/img]

[h2]New weapon[/h2]
[b]Egg launcher[/b] - A double-edged gun… weapon that throws exploding eggs. Some of the eggs may hatch enemies, but that's a risk you have to be willing to take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/b3fb25898189b48c3268036d9701deb34d66ab4c.gif[/img]

[h2]New perk[/h2]
[b]Dash Attack[/b] - While dashing, you shoot additional bullets to the sides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/fbb50e54658cafd3db20598185cb678b383be374.gif[/img]

[h2]New special item[/h2]
[b]Chilli Pepper[/b] - Hot stuff, that generates a lava line, that damages enemies. Also makes your next toilet visit painful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/df1f715997cdd3fd53d15d041457f5da74e30dc9.gif[/img]

[h2]New enemies[/h2]
[b]Dog Healers[/b] - Think of shaman dogs, relentlessly healing other enemies. So you need to kill them fast. Sorry, PETA!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c2ced6e132d7745b43978e6d4b44d9712b32cf9d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/e6b141e575f6a79e9090db3b2142cf13fe54a358.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New mechanic - Critical Hits[/h2]
With this update, we introduce [b]a Critical Hits mechanic[/b]. For the time being, all weapons have a fixed amount of chance for a hit with double damage. With the future patches, you can expect an addition of a sponsor bonus, special item, and perk, allowing you to further increase a chance for Critical Hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c727efc49b134ef889c6e6a1433aa9e53b6bfd1c.gif[/img]

[h2]Balance tweaks[/h2]
We have read hundreds of comments, seen dozens of videos, had multiple discussions in the studio about the balance of the game, and we have decided to tweak it further.

The main goal of the new changes is to nerf OP combinations of perks, weapons, and special items. The ones in which you can kill the boss within a couple of seconds. But don’t worry. They are not drastic, and we have also buffed less commonly used weapons. These adjustments are also taking into consideration the new Critical Hits mechanic.

We have also tweaked co-op - enemy health gain per additional player is now lower, teammates can be revived for 50% longer, while the time needed to get them back on their feet is now reduced.

Feel free to ping us on any channel you wish with your feedback regarding the changes! Thanks to your reports, we have also managed to fix another wave of bugs reported from you throughout January. Let’s take a look:

[h3]0.9.5 Changelog[/h3]

[b]New Features: [/b]
- Episode 14 with Wack-a-Ctopus boss
- New enemy - Dog Healer - appears in episodes 9, 10, 12 and 14
- New weapon - Egg Launcher
- New perk - Dash Attack
- New special item - Chilli Pepper
- Weapon Critical Hits System

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Empty Stages sponsor renamed to Practice Stage. Now instead of an empty stage, there will be some harmless target dummies instead
- Remote Play instructions and Discord links from Lobby
- Players are now invincible longer after revive
- DJ Horse music is louder

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
- Hugger boss is now slightly tougher and more aggressive
- Almost all minibosses have more HP
- Enemies in co-op have slightly less HP
- Players have more time to revive a friend and revive is quicker

- Fame and Likes Boost bonus from Boost stages increased
- Damage bonus from Boost stages reduced

- Lob-o-gun hits now receive a small area of effect
- Shotgun now shots slightly less frequent
- Vortex Gun bullets are now faster and has Piercing and Area of Effect at hit
- Rubberball has increased damage
- Grow-o-Ball bullets are now faster
- Boomerang has increased damage and cooldown 0.5s
- Indecisive Gun damage increased
- Melody Gun consecutive bullets damage increased
- Rocket Launcher Area of Effect range reduced
- Crazy Shotgun have less bullets and less damage
- Glue Gun damage increased

- Reduced damage multiplier for Damage Boost and Damage Boost Aura perks
- Reduced shoot speed multiplier for Rapid Fire and Rapid Fire Aura perks
- Reduced damage resist a chance for Stone Skin and Stone Skin Aura perks
- Reduced bounces count for Bouncy Bullets perk
- Reduced damage multiplier for Maniac perk
- Reduced shoot frequency multiplier for Frenzy perk
- Reduced damage for additional bullets in Split Bullet perk
- Taunt duration and charges reduced
- Vampire cooldown increased
- Area Damage perk radius reduced

- Elite Turbo Snails moved from episode 13 to 14
- Elite Worms no longer appear in episode 9
- Elite Canaries no longer appear in episodes 8, 9 and 11
- Common Hornets moved from episode 10 to 13
- Common Chaingun Crab moved from episode 9 to 13
- Common Penguins now also appear in episode 9
- Common Golems no longer appear in episode 12
- Common Rat Shamans moved from episode 12 to 14

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Faster keyboard bindings scroll speed
- Simplified entrance collider to avoid glitches
- Fix for the situation when not every enemy gets damaged if more than one enemy is affected by a hit
- Fix for randomization of damage floating texts position
- Fix for stun-lock when player hitting "back" and other player hitting "accept" in the same moment in Perks Stages
- Damage and Poison areas CPU performance improved
- Fix an issue with Rapid Fire Aura not worn off properly after using Mutation Potion
- Fix for flying enemies that are being affected by ground effects
- Fix for problems with switching Railgun weapon
- Fixed the bug where your shoots are blocked if you have a very high fire rate

Now the team moves on to work on the next Season 3 episodes, new weapons, new perks & special items. And yes, we didn’t forget about the music variety, it’s still coming!

notes.title: The Crackpet Show #1 January Content update - 0.8.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c84138fec01eb405c548b94051c8cadf6a3ea539.png[/img]

Dear animal-freakshow-lovers,

We are back! We’ve successfully entered a new year at full throttle, and today we proudly announce the start of a brand new season of [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]! 

Our furry unbreakable participants go to The City for the first time to beat new enemies like Turbo Snails and Spiders and fight their way to face not-so-pleasant Blind Hugger - a brand new boss!

Let’s take a look at what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/cfe9fa80fbe434e3dd22233be15520865d886b14.jpg[/img]

[h2]New weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Rubberball[/b] - Shoots, one of three, bouncing projectiles. You may try to catch them, or just wait for them to stop bouncing and come back (it may take a while). Has a tendency to make some serious mess.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Glue Gun[/b] - A state of art used bubble gum dispenser. Shoots two bullets that immobilize opponents for some time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f70be26eff2e64bef13f56d196369232f24aab02.gif[/img]

[h2]New perk[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Trophies Collector[/b] - You get an additional trophy after killing the boss. It's part of our new promotion.
[/list]
[h2]New special item[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mutation Potion[/b] - Gives all unlocked perks for a certain amount of time
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/cfa41d33e3a4a7cb8d8ab6332644871065d13312.gif[/img]

[h2]New enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Turbo Snails[/b] - a very far cousin of a regular snail. Prefers straight-line dash attacks. Elite variants do it twice in a row.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Spiders[/b] - shooting webs towards you, pulling you to deal close quarter damage. Dash to avoid being trapped. Elite variants shoot 3 webs at the same time (WWW?).
[/list]

[h2]Balance tweaks[/h2]

Now let’s talk about some balance tweaks. We’ve carefully analyzed your feedback regarding the difficulty curve of the first few episodes. Many of you pointed out that it’s not fully representative, and should be more in line with the rest of the game.

As a result, we’ve changed enemies appearing at the beginning of the game (Hello Penguins), buffed Skunks, and made some small tweaks to the number and health of the enemies.

notes.title: Expect the Unexpected #06 - The Show Roster
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/be9aff32fd3ff6e39bd6e33e549d4bca2cb0dfd9.gif[/img]

Hey, animal-freakshow-lovers!

The most bizarre TV show on the planet would be nothing without shiny and furry participants. So, today we take a look at the show roster!

[h3]🐰 Bunny 🐰[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/eff333bc57d8f2ad122dd0327b4a72c2c0eeb864.gif[/img]
[i]“I’m not the one who gives a f%&$!ck, just a middle finger.”[/i]

Bunny walks through a hooded and broken city like a typical junkie. And he lacks the cash like a typical junkie. One day, he notices a retirement home advertisement "looking for employees" on the wall. He gets the job and drugs all the old pets, for which he gets kicked out and goes back to the street. When he saw an ad "[b]The Crackpet Show[/b]", he had no choice but to join the roster. The rest is obviously obvious.


[h3]🐮 Cowie 🐮[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/98b8becb7e110ba8d883404acb75e9047403d4a4.gif[/img]
[i]“I will milk fame out of this show!”[/i]

Cowie showed above-average intelligence since a young age (she can put a block in a hole), then she became a genius and learned to put more blocks in holes, finished her studies and aspires to be a scientist known all over the world, and then notices the "[b]The Crackpet Show[/b]" ad. So not only is she one of the few who can give it all, but she is also wondering how many holes she can make with a block…


[h3]🦈 Sharky 🦈[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/1c3f825780ed8a88bf852fa5fe7d1cfabd9e9bb4.gif[/img]
[i]“I got hands just so there is blood on them!”[/i]

Sharky is the typical idiot nerd. He surrounds himself with the same idiot nerds though the most nerdy thing about him is counting the blood stains on his body. Just walked by the "[b]The Crackpet Show[/b]" banner and had one thought: "bloody hell, I’m in!”


[h3]🐔 Rusty 🐔[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f715431cc389e98c8abcff13e9c6f4063a0535bf.gif[/img]
[i]“My smile is equal to your luck against me.”[/i]

Rusty is a classic veteran soldier who has flashes of light, struggles with bouts of aggression and a constant urge for adrenaline. notes.title: Expect the Unexpected #05 - Show me the money!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/55c70d9ace8bdcda35414d4e24a24fe4ba8cc315.png[/img]

Welcome back to the Expect the Unexpected series! In The Crackpet Show you work your a** to become famous and get some sweet sponsorship deals! Their support is the case of life and death, so let's take a look at your options!

[h3][b]Happy Three Foes[/b][/h3]
There are 3 sponsors that are on the edge of giving you support, if you show them that you're worthy! 

These are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/aa8bc80423b1ca61cbcf1e72658953e9c6bf2bf6.png[/img]

[b]KangaRum[/b] - Rumors say they really like percentages, although they are not really into math (maybe if you exchange "a" with "e"). Nonetheless, they will support your health.

[b]LoanShark[/b] - They know Wolf from Wall Street from primary school, although they quickly ended education and went all-in into crypto and NFTs. They will support your like and perk gains.

[b]DirtyKittens[/b] - They grew up in Murica, so of course, the huge pile of money they got came from selling guns. Mr Parrot, the host of the show, is their friend, so they will help you with bending the rules here and there.

So, let's take a look at a few examples:

[b]Double Dash[/b] - You can do the second dash instantly
[b]Extra Health[/b] - You can have one more max health
[b]Perk Stage Upgrade[/b] - One more perk machine in Perk Stages

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/9641d908ea7f3911d34581cfea48b0a7a201dc9f.gif[/img]

It's all about adapting it to your favorite playstyle. And best of all, once you choose to upgrade, you keep it even if you die. 

[h3][b]Opening up[/b][/h3]
Sponsor bonuses give you also the ability to unlock 4 new room types for your episodes!

These are:
[list]
[*] [b]Healing rooms[/b] - by clearing this room, all characters will regain their health
[*] [b]Blessing rooms[/b] - by completing this room, all characters get a passive boost for the rest of the episode (like increased damage)
[*] [b]Fame rooms[/b] - by completing this room, all characters receive fame bonus, used for upgrades, based on the time of killing all of the enemies
[*] [b]Social rooms[/b] - by finishing this room, all characters receive an extra amount of like. The faster you kill everyone, the higher gains you get.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f72aeb1dadc8f010069f60a35c582e57c53afdad.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The trophies without the cabinet[/b][/h3]
Whenever you kill the boss, you are rewarded by the host with trophies. So don't forget to grab them! And you don't need an old-fashioned cabinet for the trophies you got because you exchange them for sponsor bonuses. However, our gritty businessmen want more and more, so the better the bonus is, the higher is its cost. 

But we've mentioned flexibility, right? You don't need the reset button because you can turn on and off sponsorship bonuses. Protip: if you wish to reset the whole set from a particular sponsor, turn off the first bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/bfd56f2d1a50c9ed6500e75e6874c16ee81521f5.gif[/img]

So there you have it. And good luck with fighting for some sweet sponsorships!

notes.title: Expect the Unexpected #04 - Talent Show
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/de44618cc51986a559ac1269cc88871526e7cf58.jpg[/img]

Welcome back to [i]the Expect the Unexpected series[/i]! Today it’s all about showing all you’ve got by clearing stages and getting new perks along the way. Don’t you think you’re ready because you obtained a mighty-looking gun (which we covered in the last episode of the series). This is [b][i]the Crackpet Show[/i][/b], and it’s all about mixing perks, guns, and special items.

[h3][b]Before you start[/b][/h3]
Lights out and away we go! Or wait… There is no wardrobe in this bizarre TV show (in fact, all participants don’t use clothes, yikes), but what they really need are perks.

So, at the beginning, you end up in a room when a selection of perks spawn. These passive boosters increase your mobility, weapon capabilities or even grant you a brand new skill! Let’s take a look at a few examples:
[list]
[*] [b]Damage Boost Aura[/b] - An aura surrounds you, increasing the attack speed of you and your teammates who are inside the aura. [perfect in co-op]
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Steel Shoes[/b] - Makes you immune to traps. [there are rooms full of it]
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Bouncy Bullets[/b] - Your projectiles bounce off walls. [it’s so powerful with the right weapon!]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/2e2ad7b95ab46603eaf2e66fc7da760ae746c444.gif[/img]

There is no perfect combination - it all depends on the current episode, weapon, whether you play solo or in a co-op. On top of that, perks are stackable, so you keep them until you die or finish an episode once you obtain it. So try to look for the best combos! 

[h3][b]Testing your friendship[/b][/h3]
When you play in a co-op mode, you choose from the same pool of perks between yourselves. However, you can’t magically duplicate them, so if you both opt for the same one, you begin a fighting mini-game.

The winner keeps the perk, but the loser needs to choose another one. So, playing in a 4-player co-op might result in another fight or a least appealing perk. But hey, no risk, no fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/ff11a7cd4104eb0ee16ec8f7e82da14a63c59000.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Perk room is my friend[/b][/h3]
Rooms marked with a fish icon are the ones that grant you a new wave of perks after finishing it. Those marked with a skull icon have a more serious difficulty, although they give you a chance to pick up an additional perk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/d15a6e00a0f2d616ec722d391535f6e88ff22f5f.gif[/img]

Once you gain access to the perk for the first time, you unlock it. It means that by finishing an episode, you can upgrade it, making it more powerful the next time it pops out for you. Each perk has 3 levels - so 2 upgrades in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/829651aea2d16c65191137d7053bdc3c4d5895e2.gif[/img]

So there you have it. And good luck - good luck with the fights for the best perks - within the show, and with your friends.

In the next episode of "Expect the Unexpected", we will cover sponsor bonuses, allowing you to get access to new gameplay mechanics. Stay tuned!

[i][b]The Crackpet Show[/b][/i] is split into worlds and levels, referred to as seasons and episodes. The first two seasons will be available right away, each of them consisting of 6 episodes. Yessss, 12 bosses at the launch of Early Access!

To have even a slight chance to survive, you need some proper tools of mayhem. And for all the contestants during the grand premiere of the first two seasons of [i][b]The Crackpet Show[/b][/i], you will select from:
[list]
[*] 32 weapons
[/list][list]
[*] 28 perks
[/list][list]
[*] 29 special items
[/list][list]
[*] 33 sponsor deals
[/list][list]
[*] and over 100 enemy variants!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/9db2d278ee4e874c0eb0ec63c6ce187cc2e7bfb8.gif[/img]

You can have 1-2 weapons, 1-12 perks, 1 special item, and up 33 sponsor deals. Can you count all the gameplay combinations? And it doesn’t stop here! Each of the 12 episodes has a randomly generated path within one out of 2 biomes, with a randomly chosen room layout. 

Season three — consisting of six new episodes and a new location: [i]Petopolis[/i] — will be added throughout the Steam Early Access period. It will include a ton of exciting new content for players to experiment with, on their own or with up to three friends.

[list]
[*] [b]Crazy Contestants[/b]: New playable characters join the chaos, including Goat, whose dreams of stardom go back to when they were just a wee kid. But do they have what it takes to become the Greatest Of All Time?
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Rabid Foes and Brutal Bosses[/b]: Face new threats to your fame, like Turbo Snails and Dog Healers, and come up against colossal new bosses like the spike-covered Blind Hugger. He just wants to love you, give him a chance!
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Weird and Devastating Weapons[/b]: Upgrade your arsenal with new weapons like the glue gun and egg launcher! Sure, they don’t sound dangerous, but have you ever actually been hit by an egg flying as fast as a bullet? It HURTS.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Inventive Items and Helpful Perks[/b]: New items and perks give you more destructive combinations to play with! Just imagine the damage you could do with a chili pepper and a dash attack!
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Even More Content[/b]: Sponsorship bonuses, decorations, secret rooms, Easter eggs, and more will all be added during the early access period! Gotta keep the show fresh to maintain those ratings!
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/7f150f2a4ad487fb3efa61c43f08cc350f47813f.jpg[/img]

Welcome back to [b]the Expect the Unexpected series[/b]! Don't forget to check out the first two episodes of the series before diving into all the tools you get by entering this bizarre show. In the end, you don't start watching your favorite Netflix series from the 3rd episode, right?

[h3][b]Starting Weapons[/b][/h3]
Oh yessss… The tools of mayhem, the blood messengers, the chaos machines! In [b]The Crackpet Show[/b], there is no easy route for finding the best weapon and sticking to it. You do remember that likes and weapons stick to you only during the episode you're currently in? So don't save for later. Just try to pick the best option for the current scenario!

When you start an episode, you have [b]4 primary weapons[/b] to choose from (by picking an associated class):

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/84a72afe676900d76d2dbdf01518e134a91466e7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/1bbf4339789c35c8349009a2f6cbd2c355ab70c4.png[/img][/url][b]Pew Gun[/b] - Just a regular gun.Nothing special. Move along and kill some things.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/477cb40e6138ebc8c8d90cd9cff998f1de432f55.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/92ac60b6bacf0ee96696c6f3e4e5e7861e527c71.png[/img][/url] [b]Zap Gun[/b] - Sometimes stuns enemies. An electric eel without the eel.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/ce109a143ae901ae832b082935c75c17d6f20f83.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/b6063fad6932c2d2e241e534b89b17679bbf7e2c.png[/img][/url] [b]Lob-o-Gun[/b] - Throws bullets instead of shooting. It's a feature, not a bug.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/68c285c361d97529b4b8a9196d58d490b4f41647.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/018688b98ff2372c3e067e53a1f4049de1c4b445.png[/img][/url] [b]Shotgun[/b] - Fires 3 bullets simultaneously. Runs on duct tape and hope.

Each has its own strengths and weaknesses. For instance, Lob-o-Gun will be perfect for a room layout with lots of covers, giving the power of physics into your furry hands:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/568d25acfaf318c18742e982c08f827c09f659fc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Getting more epic stuff[/b][/h3]
Okay, okay, you're here for the more crazy stuff, huh? Forget about drops from enemies (these are reserved for likes), and focus on finding weapon rooms. After finishing a stage of this kind, a weapon vending machine will spawn, giving you a random piece.

There are also elite room variants of weapons rooms (with a skull in the top-right corner), which increases the chances for elite rifles to spawn (marked with purple). Be aware, though, as you will encounter more deadly enemies and increase the risk of losing precious health.

You can also make use of likes and buy weapons at shops (the offer changes randomly) or even sell the current weapon for likes to secure a deal of the day! BTW, do you see a "mysteriously hidden" character in the top-left corner? If you consider yourself lucky, this might be the game-changer - as it rerolls the currently wielded weapon. It might be an epic one, making the upcoming boss fight a much less painful experience, but it can also give you a basic crap you don't like. No risk, no fun, huh?

[h3][b]Epic tools[/b][/h3]
So let's see three examples of the beautifully crafted tools of carnage, ready for your disposal:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/12176b5b1be2c341874c6eab6ccfe3b15bcfd1cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/451fbd915043df2a84549b0db7a386222b8c3ec5.png[/img][/url][b]Mega Rail Gun[/b] An instant hit with very high damage, but also a very slow reload. Why settle for something normal when you can have it in MEGA version?


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f04f894445c0c568cbb3d9cd8bf07bffd289a68c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/d5a57f32f93f3b9d8404fd2d7bae6b4b32d20ccc.png[/img][/url][b]Melody gun[/b] Fires more powerful bullets the longer you hold down the fire button. Don't release it at all, actually! Try to keep the rhythm to kill your enemies.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f9d6c232b1a4a4092c3b38e24fa090e59cdf922b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/387f74dfeab569009838e9bbc5a5b43fe569bc3e.png[/img][/url][b]Fireworks[/b] Decay into smaller projectiles on impact. A combination of beautiful colored flames and twinkling sparks. Can't wait for New Year's Eve? You hate New Year's Eve? Regardless of your answer, making use of fireworks bullets should bring you joy while crushing your opponents!

[h3][b]Special items[/b][/h3]
Weapons are not the only helpful stuff at your disposal. When you choose a specific class in the starting room, it is a combination of a weapon AND a special item.

Active skills could be more offensive (good old turret) or defensive (bandage recovering part of your health). They usually come with limited usage, though (per episode) and their own respawn, so the overall best strategy is to use them when sh&!#t hits the fan or when facing the boss at the end of an episode.

The primary special items are:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/ae597b44b3bbff5cf52d9495ce6ac1f33787f507.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/7e14fb5d27af4fffa04a7f11c1149f83e2f07227.png[/img][/url][b]Anvil drop[/b] - Smacks an enemy with an anvil. Deals <color=#5bf9ff>damage</color> and is quite funny.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f18fb794018e00410ee290d2e8de39434f6cfa4b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/5639fe0d20daf4d97912a770c32faf13ef53f19e.png[/img][/url][b]Turret[/b] - Places a turret on the ground that shoots enemies with your weapon.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/057641fcaede7baaeb9070af5c493eeb026e90be.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/3f7dc286acc47926fb55c3e3a08373d4f45a79b6.png[/img][/url][b]Bandages[/b] - An awesome healing package. Use to restore 1 health.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/e1e9dc8780003486b0cbcf2118766ea8af4a584b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/bad19c7903bbb18f9d1517e9ef9fc2e8c149e018.png[/img][/url][b]Taunt[/b] - Provokes enemies to attack you for a short time. Additionally, grants invulnerability during this period. No strings attached.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/b90df952cbd99abd87e6698e8a9c0558176393bb.gif[/img]

When you are a newbie, it might not be a bad idea to start with healing bandages because you will most likely get hit very often in the beginning.

Let's not spoil too much of the epic special items, but [b]Call of Zeus[/b] is literally shockingly good! It strikes an enemy and stuns them. The effect jumps to nearby enemies. And it looks incredible:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/69979685aef96a0ef66d6b07d79ff01a5814759a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Sticking an upgrade[/b][/h3]
When you finish an episode, you get trophies that are exchangeable for upgrades. This applies not only to weapons but also to perks and unique items. For example, a trashy pew gun on level 1 might become a perfect rifle at level 3, making it one of the best you can wield. 

And yeah, it works relatively simply - at the start, everything is on level 1, and you can upgrade it to a level 3. And best of all, those upgrades stick with you, making you much more powerful ahead of more difficult bosses and enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/14536397e9ae6b1e7e3e378df0474894a66a1662.gif[/img]

[b]Coming up next…[/b]
In the next episode of "Expect the Unexpected", we will cover perks, associated mini-game, and how to find the perfect combinations with weapons you currently wield!

notes.title: Expect the Unexpected #02 - Show must go on
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/eff697cd3f11db19c7fb135eac7c9f2ccfe2b6be.png[/img]

Welcome back to the Expect the Unexpected series! If you have missed the first episode, covering aiming, dash, and likes mechanics, you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1390700/announcements/detail/4244072077612961044]read it[/url] to get the basics of survival in [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]. 

Now we assume you're ready to survive the first episode, so it might be helpful to know what happens next, don't you think?

[h2][b]Randomized episodes[/b][/h2]

Finishing a season of [b]TCS[/b] is not anything like bingeing your favorite Netflix show. But imagine how awesome it would be to have an episode with a slightly different outcome each time? Not only do you get that in our bizarre show, but each time you start a new episode, a randomized grid of multiple paths with different kinds of rooms is generated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c9e9e65e4715bc170156b36b70102138149b50ae.gif[/img]

So here comes the strategic part. Will you risk going through an elite version of the room for a chance to acquire a deadly weapon or play it safe to gain more likes and exchange them for some lethal tools?

There isn't one best way to approach it - it all depends on your favorite playstyle, current weapon, set of active perks, and whether you play solo or in co-op. But having all these tools means that you can adapt the events to your liking. The one thing stays the same. Yeah, you guessed it - the boss. Your ultimate verification of being ready for the next episode of the show. 



[h2][b]The animals you’re going to dislike[/b][/h2]

And speaking of bosses. Which animal is your least favorite? Mole? Cockroach? Toad? Well, that list might grow after taking part in [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]. Their health bar is long, their skills upgraded, and they will throw thousands of bullets at you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/e6550cc293b05f1fc88a0dc9f1ca50c272df9f28.gif[/img]

The good old strategy of learning boss moves is the key here, but you also need to prepare for an even more deadly second phase after their health bar is depleted by half. So again, the best strategy is to use the room's covers and be on the move. It's also wise to save your special items for this occasion and just use all you've got.


[h2][b]Finishing an episode[/b][/h2]

So, you successfully avoided all the bullets and managed to survive two phases of deadly attacks? Hooray! Now you can see the summary of your run. All stats like the number of enemies killed, the number of likes left, a fight with a boss, and mini-bosses result in your fame boost! 

The fame points are used to get the support of sponsors - which we are going to cover in one of the future episodes. But, in a glimpse, they are passive bonuses that stay with you on each run.

So, what is the difference between life and death? Not going to run a philosophy dispute here because, in [b]The Crackpet Show[/b], things work very clearly in this regard - apart from MORE FAMEEEE, you also unlock the next episode. But whether you repeat the same run or go for the next one, the rest of the rules apply.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/0ec03becf0ac65c1fbff649be8569aeed6ecba11.gif[/img]

[i][b]Let's play a small yes-no mini-game about what you keep and what you don't:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Weapons - No
[*] Likes - No
[*] Perks - No
[*] Sponsors - Yes
[*] Perk upgrades - Yes
[*] Weapon upgrades - Yes
[*] Special items upgrades - Yes
[/list]

Yes, you heard that right. If you thought, "I'll just stick to my favorite weapon." or "Will save likes for later." or "This perk might be handy in the long run." - this is not going to work. [b]The Crackpet Show[/b] demands a good strategy here and now, based on the available tools. But going out of your comfort zone can help you discover more playstyles, more awesome perks, and weapons combinations - a true highlight of the show!

[h3][b]Coming up next…[/b][/h3]
In the next episode of "Expect the Unexpected", we will cover different weapons, special items, and ways to upgrade them. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Expect the Unexpected #01 - Welcome to the show!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/c73d4faf6c1401f5238aed0358fcf84b0523dab1.png[/img]

[b]Expect the Unexpected #01 - Welcome to the show[/b]
[i]Aiming, dash & likes mechanic[/i]

Welcome! The Expect the Unexpected series brings you insights into the upcoming most bizarre TV Show! First, you need to know that things in here… well, work differently than in real life (thank God!).

In the upcoming six episodes, we will explain to you all the nitty-gritty of [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]. Let's start today with the basics you need to understand to survive even the first episode.

[b]Aiming - risk and reward[/b]
Let's get straight to the point - you can't shoot and run fast at the same time. But believe us, it is not a huge deal! We've designed it as a part of the risk and reward system, a core of our game. Being effective means that you are on the edge of getting hit, but you still manage to finish firing just a split second before receiving a bullet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/d9c328f896069bac349d91ede957b3bfab90ed86.png[/img]

Speaking of bullets, this game is. Well... a bullet-hell, so you need to constantly look at your enemies' projectiles and keep avoiding them. Aiming your gun at the same time would be backbreaking, so you don't need to bother about it - your beastie takes care of it by itself. Just make sure that your enemy is within the weapon's range.


[b]Dash, dash, dash[/b]
Remember the song "I'm still standing"? If not, even better, because you need to be constantly on the move, and you die rather quickly if you don't. Dash is your best friend because when you perform a quick roll, you become immune to bullets for a short while. You need to plan your moves carefully, though, because rooms might have all sorts of traps, or there might be another enemy in a better position, ready to hurt you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/eac57c3f55a71c84f08dbe4613ad1031fc768a9c.gif[/img]

The dash also has a short cooldown, but each beastie has its exact duration, so you can get used to it and train your muscle memory. Do you remember that [b]The Crackpet Show[/b] is all about getting fame and securing some sweet sponsorship deals (more on that in the future episodes!)? One of them can double your dash. Definitely worth considering. 

[b]Likes[/b]
Whether you are a social media freak or laugh whenever you see someone thinking that likes are essential in their lives, you need to know that they really mean something in [b]The Crackpet Show[/b]. After clearing each room, you get a small number of likes (dopamine, yay!) for each mob killed. 

But, if you the kind of person finishing the game with full pockets and shi*tload of money, we've got some bad news. In the end, TCS is a rogue-lite shoot'em'up and likes stay with you only until the end of each run. So, whenever you enter the shop, consider buying weapons, perks, and precious health boosters. Especially before encountering one of the bosses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/6e560f038559cc1ced1b53e10d93fda4c1bda87c.gif[/img]

When you play with your friends in a local co-op, your whole team shares the likes pool. A true test of your friendship and tactical thinking with resource management!

Coming up next…
In the next episode of "Expect the Unexpected", we will talk you through runs, choosing rooms, encountering bosses, and what happens after your death. See you soon!

notes.content:

[b][i]One of the first concepts for The Crackpet Show[/i][/b]


The Vixa Games production set was ready in early 2020. During that time, our board of TV show directors discussed the potential setting (or, in other words, are asses firing bullets ok?). On top of that, Karol, our art director, had lots of fun by designing the tools of mayhem - we already knew at that time that TCS would take you on the rouge-like bullet-hell adventure. And yeah, what an adventure that would be without proper bosses? Klaudzia, our graphic designer said that DJ Horse is one of her favourites, and it was inspired by her party outfit (don’t judge!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/0eee427b070e54b1230d724763b03fd5f41498d3.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Can you guess which weapon(s) made it to the final game? [/i][/b]


We are a small indie studio from Poland, and like (almost) all small indie studios, we were too optimistic (looking at you Spav, our game designer). In the beginning, we thought that the game would be ready to launch in Early Access after a year of production. Well, here we are, 20 months later. At least we didn't share the launch window at that time, so you didn't have to read the "yeah, we are sorry" PR statements. Fingers crossed you never will from us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/45e1432f11be869030174bf8b991d4165195c6cf.gif[/img]
[b][i]Just a typical Monday on the set of The Crackpet Show[/i][/b]



A few months later, the game started to look closer to today's build. First, we added some blood, then more blood, and then some gore (and blood). [b]Bunny[/b], [b]Cowie[/b], [b]Rusty[/b], and [b]Sharky[/b], our characters, were animated correctly, alive, and ready to make (or break) your friendships via a couch co-op.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/3e1e2b640a82f4d5b86de92d4d0fe26538def1c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/e0a0fd6e2883a9bea238953af51219d109e0f25d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/e625f4a50fa6978e0976196deced8cebc4fe285d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/0b02c4cbe6f8c609d7bc21c14caa06ae9d308e5a.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/37616b12d0168d55997d05037a71d158f2d8ab7b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/6debe0340716d554f8e8c99b9e9fd517ac9b5e20.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/8e4c17d26a64189ea6346bdb77a51f6acce24a7c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/f86615b70685266264298c78ae31ee354a478573.png[/img][/url]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/5e19ec0a3a28338d68e02d0ec79a3549e0c4fd0e.png[/img]
[b][i]Yeah, we do some cheating sometimes.[/i][/b]

We have asked Kuro, our programmer, about the most challenging part of coding The Crackpet Show. "Bounce" and "Rubber ball" -  perks and weapons that affect the physics and increase mayhem to the max. Bob is most proud of the in-house level editor that gave us the much-needed boost in developing new stages. Serek worked hard to ensure that you can "revive" your fellow beasties while playing in a couch co-op mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/2d478033a5b1fc39d7d4dcd8915b316de76372d8.gif[/img]
[b][i]It's tempting to stop moving during a revive, but this is how it usually ends…[/i][/b]


Juliusz, our CEO AKA The Master of Steam, prepared us for the Summer Festival when we shared a glimpse of The Crackpet Show with you! At the end of the demo, a link to a survey helped us make a... cracking progress! 

Could you make a better week to start as a PR Manager than gamescom time, especially when IGN features your game? When Robert joined Vixa Games, the buzz was all around, and we are incredibly grateful for all the support you gave us!



And here we are, together with our friends at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/ravenage/]Ravenage[/url] we have entered the final stage before the Early Access release! Thanks to their support, we are able to bring you even more beasties, weapons, perks, and a few surprises! Dominika joined the art team during that time, and she has been working on the content for future episodes updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/27187e73e508d199f69d9e61ed1906c9c840c9c7.jpg[/img]
[b][i]A concept of workbench, coming to one of the future episodes![/i][/b]

And speaking of future episodes, we are planning to share the roadmap with you closer to the show's grand premiere.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Story behind the craziest TV Show on the planet! The Crackpet Tales #1
notes.content:
[h1]The story behind the apocalypse, the rise of champions, and the wicked Show!
[/h1]

[b]An apocalyptic event that occurred without warning changing the fate of the planet as we know by annihilating mankind. It turned the surface into a hazardous area poisoning and mutating all creatures that managed to survive the catastrophe. Those creatures became the main habitats of the devastated world and among them are the worst kind - The Crackpets![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/68cd3ffc998b50efd938215b8e282830a27cbc67.jpg[/img]

[b]The world as we know collapses, governments and civilizations fall, the new age dawns and entire swaths of people are extinct… Rules, laws, relationships, etiquette, habits - everything about society has been remade and formed novum that no one could predict in their wildest dreams - everyone solely survives on entertainment. Their definition of “fun” is completely different from what it used to mean. The animals created the only way to satisfy their urges of enjoyment.

Their crazy brains invented a TV Show that is broadcasted worldwide! Some of the creatures spiral into madness, some discover the insatiable lust for entertainment others use their craziness to provide it. Silly mutated brains decided to choose a leader and they have decided to choose in their own wicked way. The TV Show where the most insane champions take part is not only to provide an epic blast - it's the only thing that is left in this world.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39004041/01f5df3f19861e01b2012121a4e1595d527c3c9f.jpg[/img]

[b]Champions known as The Crackpets take part in deadly arena matches to satisfy the urges of cruelty, greed, and carnage - basic pandemonium of wickedness which in the new dictionary is the definition of fun. Victory is only secondary here, what matters is to become the ultimate hero of the masses. The number one is chosen by the spectrum of fame, likes, approval, skills, tricks, uncontrollable wickedness, and ability to round up the masses thanks to the non-controlled bloodshed.

Up to four champions can enter the arena and cooperate to survive enemies and bosses like DJ Horse, Hugger, Junk Queen and that’s just the start! Get through each of the seasons in the most roguelike bullet-hell way possible, oh and obviously don't forget about mayhem... Get the full recognition from watching psycho-brains by creating epic carnage!

The main inspiration for the game has been the “Happy Tree Friends” cartoon. The gore and graphics are a reflection of the characters' lust for blood and their craziness. Amongst many others titles like Archero, Enter the Dungeon we hope that these resemblances are there.[/b]

[h2]VIXA GAMES TEAM[/h2]
